item.title: Reliable and Unreliable Narrators in Novels with Multiple Points of View — Rashmi Vaish | Numéro Cinq
item.description: In novels with multiple points of view, however, this pressure is alleviated. We get a variety of views on the novel world, each perspective coloring the same events in different hues. One perspective is set up against the other and so we as readers discover for ourselves which narration holds the most reliability or unreliability.
